name: Infinite 2D Shooter
author: hagould
description: While exploring a new world you are ambushed by a seemingly endless spawn of enemies! You might as well kill as many as you can before your inevitable death..                                                                                         Controls are FORWARD: W, BACKWARD: S, Rotate Left: D, Rotate Right: A (Yes I know it is opposite but I kind of liked it that way.)                                                                                    All sprites taken from: https://opengameart.org/
